notes: No genre is named, but climbable walls and trusses leading up to high platforms with the stated aim of reaching the top is a tower climb, which the index files under Obby & Platformer, so this is a genre match rather than the no-genre file and it carries the genre-wide P6. The shape answer asks for a straight-up tower, so course-tower, and its P2 is earned because platforms stacking directly above each other is exactly what was requested. Took Tower Obby but dropped its obstacle-timing, because the theme answer asks to keep it simple with just walls, trusses and platforms and vanishing timed tiles would be an instruction the prompt argues against; obstacle-climb is the direct match for the trusses and wall scrambles, and I added obstacle-jump for the stepped high platforms. Deciding without a user: winner-zone sits at the summit since the goal answer names reaching the top, checkpoints stay off as they do in this preset because nothing asked for them on a short simple climb, and the R15 requirement is a character rig choice with no layout consequence beyond keeping gaps inside the default jump limits.
